mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which signals reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO below 100), a decline in industrial production signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings headwinds, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in year-over-year CPI inflation above 2.0% signals a potential shift toward tighter monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime (HOUST above 1100 thousand units), a sustained increase in housing starts signals strong consumer confidence and rising disposable income, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1100, or Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 in a single month signals a manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
